fields.description: Known for their acrobatic spinning jumps above the water surface. These dolphins are commonly spotted in the waters off Nagapattinam and along the Tamil Nadu coast.
fields.habitat: Tropical and subtropical deep waters, typically found in pods of 100-500 individuals.
fields.behavior: Highly social, often seen bow-riding with boats and performing aerial acrobatics.
fields.identification: Slender body with a long beak, distinctive three-colored pattern (dark gray back, lighter gray sides, white belly).

fields.description: Large baleen whales known for their complex songs and spectacular breaching behavior. Migrates through Tamil Nadu waters during winter months.
fields.habitat: Temperate and tropical waters, typically near coastlines during migration.
fields.behavior: Known for spectacular breaches, complex songs, and cooperative bubble-net feeding.
fields.identification: Large body (14-17m), distinctive long pectoral fins, knobby head, and unique tail patterns.

fields.description: One of the largest sea turtles, found in tropical and subtropical waters. Nests on beaches along the Tamil Nadu coast, particularly in Ramanathapuram district.
fields.habitat: Shallow coastal waters, seagrass beds, and coral reefs.
fields.behavior: Migrates long distances between feeding and nesting grounds, returns to natal beaches to nest.
fields.identification: Smooth, heart-shaped carapace, large front flippers, and distinctive scute pattern.

fields.description: The largest known living fish species, reaching lengths of up to 12 meters. Found in warm waters off the Tamil Nadu coast, particularly in the Gulf of Mannar.
fields.habitat: Open ocean and coastal waters, typically in warm tropical waters.
fields.diet: Plankton, fish eggs, and small fish (filter feeder)
fields.behavior: Gentle and slow-moving, often found near the surface feeding on plankton blooms.
fields.identification: Large body with distinctive white spots and stripes on dark gray background, wide flat head.

fields.description: Famous for their symbiotic relationship with sea anemones. Commonly found in coral reef ecosystems along the Tamil Nadu coast.
fields.habitat: Coral reefs and sea anemone hosts in shallow tropical waters.
fields.behavior: Lives in symbiosis with sea anemones, which provide protection from predators.
fields.identification: Bright orange body with three white vertical stripes outlined in black.

fields.description: A medium-sized bird of prey commonly found near coastal areas. Important scavenger in marine ecosystems.
fields.habitat: Coastal areas, estuaries, and inland waterways.
fields.behavior: Soars on thermals, often seen near fishing harbors scavenging for food.
fields.identification: Chestnut-brown body with white head and breast, yellow bill and feet.
